content: The effectiveness of high-intensity and moderate-intensity statins has been well-documented. For individuals who do not achieve their target LDL cholesterol levels with statin therapy alone, the addition of other lipid-lowering agents can be beneficial. Specifically, combining statins with ezetimibe or PCSK9 inhibitors has been shown to effectively reduce LDL cholesterol levels further. This combination therapy also helps in lowering the associated risks of cardiovascular events.
